approved_direction.material: 玫瑰紫强流动 Liquid Glass
approved_direction.motion: A 折射涟漪 + E 磁吸浮起
approved_direction.petals: A 稀疏慢落，背景层，默认低强度，可关闭

component_contracts.content_lens: Dark translucent layers preserve text contrast above decorative material.
component_contracts.edge_handle: Theme-colored vertical handle; right by default, draggable to left.
component_contracts.icons: Simple single-color system icons; independent 花 mark for tray and installer icon.
component_contracts.record_row: Stable 52px class height, type icon, primary content, metadata, pin/favorite state.
component_contracts.settings: Unframed two-column settings window with appearance, motion, input, clipboard, privacy, behavior, displays, and system sections.

interaction_contracts.middle_click: Intercept only after the cursor panel opens successfully; excluded apps retain native middle-click behavior.
interaction_contracts.single_click: Copy the selected record and hide the cursor panel after success.
interaction_contracts.double_click_or_enter: Copy, return focus to the originating window, paste, then hide; preserve clipboard content and show recovery guidance if paste fails.

prohibited_variations: rectangular native window borders outside the rounded glass silhouette
white or bright highlight strokes along the outer glass edge
petals above text or record cards

derivatives.scope: Remove the rectangular native host outline and clip the real WinUI window to the approved 29px glass silhouette.
derivatives.preserved: Layout, typography, theme colors, list behavior, settings content, petals, and A+E click motion.

derivatives.scope: Remove every XAML and native Windows frame stroke so the liquid-glass material reaches the rounded window edge without a white outline.
derivatives.preserved: Window geometry, glass fill, theme colors, layout, typography, records, settings, petals, and A+E click motion.

derivatives.scope: Apply the background-transparency setting to the liquid-glass material layers and native Desktop Acrylic backdrop instead of fading the complete panel including text and controls.
derivatives.preserved: Panel geometry, typography, themes, icons, records, settings layout, petals, A+E click motion, and all clipboard behavior.

derivatives.scope: Increase the approved typography scale for clipboard rows, settings labels, descriptions, navigation, controls, and feedback while retaining the fixed panel geometry.
derivatives.preserved: Liquid-glass material, A+E motion, five themes, icon language, panel dimensions, spacing structure, records, petals, and clipboard behavior.
